intent.content: Independent source-neutral LOCAL UNRELEASED observable-only calibration experiment. The actual production seal remains 96d8f74cf022d7515aaa0d4a8f4e103b9be8c7b776bf99794d9926ef13d8fdb4. The request current_questions is explicitly the UNACCEPTED extension-02-02 experimental baseline, not adopted production authority. Reopen only observable, as justified by the independent generic construct review. Freeze faithful, single_constraint, scoped and self_contained byte-identical to this experiment baseline. Preserve the unchanged original 17-case corpus and separate existing four-case generic supplement, their labels and all prior evidence. Add only the independently derived separate two-case recorded-approval boundary supplement, canonical SHA256 16870963aaade3f275d0def433ae9d5970438ae4e5ce28fe33330a5b6a7ab69a, frozen before any new response; this tests that human approval tied to an identified inspectable record remains observable. Do not merge or relabel existing cases. Use only the independently frozen extension-03 candidate pool SHA256 4907bfdfad8f1e0395d54e9ca6db3e7a285b843323ec688c3218dbbf91435314 and exact request shapes SHA256 32d35ec768b3ba136f6af8b8298cdd54c2b64b2405dc729d9986dcf7ca5b09fe. All 23 cases require complete five-role scoring, two byte-identical confirmations, production confidence 0.6 and confidence reference 0.8. Third calls occur only for first-pair choice disagreement; never cherry-pick or waive low confidence. No case-specific cues or confidence coaching are permitted. If the frozen faithful role remains subthreshold, report it honestly; no partial seal is valid. Empty pre-anchor authority is mandatory; no actual Phase C anchor, plan or desired consumer result is an oracle. No normative user-anchor change is authorized. Keep all prior decisions, responses, seals and the source-neutral canonical testability history sidecar; do not invent an anchor or supply forbidden tuning_history. Use the resolved local runtime and repository-confined committed optional inputs, without installed source or setting edits. Supported CLI output must equal installed redact_sensitive(frozen_body), with canonical unredacted input hashes and live digests matching. Never disable redaction. Preparation authorizes no live calls: parent materialization, independent verification and root execution approval must occur first. This is instrument testing, not production installation or Phase C readiness. No new accepted seal exists until every original, existing supplemental and recorded-approval boundary cell is exact, stable and confident.

criteria.no: A new policy, algorithm, strength, condition or required result lacks supplied authorization or conflicts with it.
criteria.unclear: The available quote and intent do not resolve whether substantive content was preserved.
criteria.yes: The obligation is supported by the quote or explicit approved intent, allowing routine formalization of its wording and output representation.

faithful.instructions: Compare the substantive requirement in anchor.statement with the supplied authority: anchor.quote together with state.intent.content when present. Extracting one quoted duty is permitted. Routine formalization includes must wording, print/log terminology expressed through stdout or stderr, and JSON output described as a JSON object when the authority does not distinguish JSON shapes. Explicit intent may add the authorization for a specific algorithm; absent intent grants no such authorization. Evaluate support for the duty, independently of its testability.

criteria.no: It supplies only a subjective quality, undefined shorthand, or an approval with no observable record.
criteria.unclear: Some evidence is named, but the observation needed to settle compliance remains ambiguous.
criteria.yes: It names evidence or behavior that can be inspected with a determinate outcome.

observable.instructions: Does anchor.statement define a checkable behavior or artifact without relying on an undefined label or an approval that has no identified record? Judge only whether the stated outcome can be observed.

criteria.no: No work area or applicability set is identifiable.
criteria.unclear: An area is named but its applicability cannot be determined.
criteria.yes: A reviewer can identify the work area where this anchor applies, including an explicit all-items set.

scoped.instructions: Do anchor.statement and anchor.scope identify the governed activity, component, artifact, or explicit global set, independent of whether the requirement itself is vague or otherwise defective?

criteria.no: At least one decisive term is an undefined quality or private label, or compliance depends on an approval with no identified record.
criteria.unclear: A possible outside-context dependency exists but the statement does not show whether it is decisive.
criteria.yes: None of those outside-context dependencies is needed; ordinary technical terms, concrete prohibitions, lists, and explicit input/action/outcome conditions are sufficient.

self_contained.instructions: Is anchor.statement independently understandable and applicable without any of these disqualifiers: an undefined subjective quality (for example robust), private shorthand, or a human approval that has no identified recorded artifact? Ignore grammar, bundling, fidelity, and scope.

criteria.no: It joins independently enforceable predicates requiring different behavior or policy.
criteria.unclear: The statement does not establish whether its clauses express one predicate or separate duties.
criteria.yes: The statement specifies one predicate, including a common predicate over several surfaces.

single_constraint.instructions: Evaluate whether anchor.statement governs one predicate. Repeating the same prohibition or outcome over terminal output, saved artifacts or other listed surfaces is one rule. A trigger restricts applicability rather than adding a separate duty. Different obligations such as formatting logs and retrying failures are independent even if the same service performs both. Ignore unused duties from the provenance quote.
